title: On the Linearity of Squarefree Powers of Edge Ideals
summary: Let $G$ be a graph and $I(G)$ its edge ideal. The $p$-th squarefree power $I(G)^{[p]}$ is the monomial ideal generated by squarefree monomials corresponding to the matchings of size $p$ of $G$. In this paper, we provide a combinatorial characterization of when $I(G)^{[p]}$ is linearly related, i.e., when its first syzygy module is generated by linear forms.
